name: bar-list
title: Bar List
description: A card ranks pages, referrers or countries as horizontal blue bars, each labelled with its name and a right-aligned count. Tabs switch the dataset and the bars resize to the new maximum.
use: A dashboard needs a compact ranking of top pages, sources or countries with share-of-total bars.
avoid: Values are encoded by bar width only against the max, so small entries look almost empty and there is no axis.
a11y: Rows are real buttons with focus rings and aria-sort, but each button exposes only the name, not its value, and widths animate regardless of motion settings. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark card with a total and a three-tab switcher at the top, then rows of blue horizontal bars sized by value, with a name inside each bar and a number right-aligned beside. A grey hint line sits at the bottom.
behaves: Switching a tab swaps the dataset and the bars spring to their new widths; hovering a row brightens it, and clicking one filters the report and prints the chosen name below.
customise: Pass a data array of name, value and optional href, plus valueFormatter, sortOrder, showAnimation and onValueChange. Colours are fixed blue and the row layout is in the source.
weight: light: A short list of divs with CSS width transitions; nothing runs between interactions.
